stem:
The diagram shows an object in front of a plane mirror and the image the mirror forms for Aarav.

Which claims about the image are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The image is upright and the same size as the object.
The image appears behind the mirror and cannot be obtained on a screen.
The image is smaller than the object.
Every mirror forms an upright image the same size as the object.

teacher.key_rationale: A plane-mirror image is upright, same size as the object, appears behind the mirror, and is virtual. Claiming it is smaller captures a wrong surface feature; extending the claim to every mirror overscopes the hinge.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote converging-lens figure into plane mirror with object and image at equal distance.
